remarks: Welcome home to this well-maintained 3-bedroom, 1.5-bath residence offering 1,574 square feet of comfortable living space on a spacious 0.31-acre corner lot. Conveniently located in the city, you'll enjoy easy access to shopping, restaurants, schools, parks, and other everyday amenities.  This charming home blends timeless character with thoughtful updates. Original wood trim and hardwood floors add warmth and charm, while new fiberglass vinyl flooring and vinyl replacement windows (installed in 2025 and 2026) provide modern comfort and efficiency. The home is being offered partially furnished, making your move even easier.  The functional layout includes a desirable first-floor laundry, a walk-up attic offering excellent storage or future expansion potential, and a dry basement featuring a professionally installed egress window—perfect for a home office, recreation room, workout space, or additional living area.  Outside, you'll appreciate the detached garage, covered patio, and nearly fully fenced backyard, creating a wonderful space for entertaining, playing games, and pets. An adjacent vacant corner lot provides additional open space and enhances the property's appeal.  Major mechanical updates provide peace of mind, including a new furnace (2022), approximately 6-year-old hot water tank, approximately 10-year-old roof, 200-amp electrical service, and blown-in insulation added in 2021 for improved energy efficiency.  New refrigerator and stove added August 2026. Utility costs are affordable, with electric, water, sewer, and trash averaging approximately $150 per month and natural gas heat averaging about $100 per month.  If you're looking for a home that offers classic character, modern updates, low utility costs, and a convenient location, this property is one you won't want to miss!
